final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and including only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, uppercased the level, took the message after the service colon on the first line, and captured the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
